name: TrustWallet
assessment:
Typical Interview Stages
HR Screening (30 mins): An initial conversation regarding your background, experience, and motivation for joining Trust Wallet.
Take-Home Technical Assignment (depending on role): A practical task (e.g., building a blockchain parser in Go, developing a specific app feature) meant to be completed within a few days.
Some roles may receive an online assessment that will be completed in 30-60 minutes
Technical Interview(s): In-depth discussions about the assessment, background, knowledge
Final Interview: A conversation with senior management or team leads to assess culture fit and final competency. (Expect to be asked some of the same questions, what you know about crypto, blockchains, how you help people who are new to bitcoin/crypto currency.
training: Discussed in interviewing/offer stage. Must be very flexible
